fields.name: admin
docs: Program administrator (devnet: owner-held key; mainnet: multisig). Cannot mint, burn or
move QLC; manages limits, the operator, pausing and member suspension.

fields.name: operator
docs: Relayer key allowed to submit deliveries, charges and refunds, always inside the limits
below, and to co-sign member registration (the member's wallet must sign too).

fields.name: mintWindowSecs
docs: Newly minted QLC is capped per rolling window; vault reuse is not capped.

fields.name: paused
docs: Stops registration, deliveries and charges. Refunds stay available.

fields.name: tokenAccount
docs: The member's QLC associated token account.

fields.name: lastChargeSeq
docs: Highest charge sequence used. A charge must use a larger number, so a sequence can never be
charged twice, even after its receipt was closed.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: One-time setup by the upgrade authority; verifies the QLC mint against the policy.

accounts.name: program
docs: Only the upgrade authority may initialize, so nobody can front-run the first call.

accounts.name: wallet
docs: The member's wallet; must sign.
